CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS audit;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA audit TO ecis_apl;
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE, INSERT ON TABLE audit.revision TO ecis_apl; GRANT SELECT, UPDATE, INSERT ON TABLE audit.camp_history TO ecis_apl;

Tom
changeSet.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lookup;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA lookup TO ecis_apl;
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE, INSERT ON TABLE lookup.lkp_child_info TO ecis_apl; GRANT SELECT, UPDATE, INSERT ON TABLE audit.lkp_child_info_history TO ecis_apl;

WITH new_revision AS ( INSERT INTO audit.revision (created_at, username, source) VALUES (current_timestamp, 'SYSTEM', 'SCRIPT') RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO audit.lkp_child_info_history ( id, id_revision, revision_type, code, translations, valid_from, valid_to, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, version ) SELECT l.id, r.id, 0, l.code, l.translations, l.valid_from, l.valid_to, l.created_at, l.created_by, l.updated_at, l.updated_by, l.version FROM lookup.lkp_child_info l CROSS JOIN new_revision r;
